---
name: "🧩 Feature"
about: Describe a new feature you are going to implement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["feature"]
---

### 🎯 Goal

Explain **what** this feature aims to achieve.  
What part of the product does it affect, and what is the end user benefit?

### 🧱 Context

Why is this feature being added?  
Reference any related tasks, issues, or discussions if relevant.

### 🧩 Implementation Plan

Describe **how** you plan to implement it — main components, new endpoints, data models, or UI changes.

### ✅ Acceptance Criteria

Describe the **conditions that must be met for this feature to be considered complete**.  
For example: expected behavior, user flows that should work, or integration points that need to be verified.

### 🔗 Related

Link any related issues, pull requests, or documentation.
